roiExplainer.subtitle: The Victorian 190 is not a single federal application. It is a coordinated two-system process involving SkillSelect and Victoria's Live in Melbourne portal.

steps.title: Submit EOI in SkillSelect
steps.desc: Your Expression of Interest sits in the federal system and records your points score, occupation, and visa subclasses selected.

steps.title: Submit ROI in Live in Melbourne
steps.desc: Your Registration of Interest is a separate Victorian submission explaining your occupation, earnings, and ties to the state.

steps.title: Victoria ranks your ROI
steps.desc: Victoria reviews occupation demand, Victorian earnings, points score, and commitment evidence before selecting candidates.

steps.title: Nomination invitation issued
steps.desc: If selected, you receive an invitation to apply for state nomination and must move quickly with supporting documents.

steps.title: 190 visa invitation follows
steps.desc: Once Victoria grants nomination, SkillSelect issues your federal 190 invitation and the visa application can be lodged.
